settings.title: One house. Four steps. One story worth telling.
settings.body:
Everyone sells a Halloween inflatable. Very few think about the whole night as one scene — the ghost in the yard, the banner on the porch, the lace on the mantel, the fifty rings for the kids who ring the bell. That's the difference. We stock the small catalogue that makes the American house a landmark on the night of October 31.

The same discipline holds through November and into December. The lace stays. The banner comes inside. The ghost folds back into its bag until next October. Nothing here was designed to be thrown out.
